notes.title: Our New Game: Home Before Winter (HBW) is Coming!
notes.content:
Your over-confident generals believed they could win this war and have their troops home before winter... but no one could anticipate the horrors of trench warfare that would stretch out for years. Home Before Winter is a turn-based, strategy game with a shoot'em up mini game. Feel the cold power of your Gatling gun rip through your enemy, mobilize your troops and send them to conquer adjacent territories, but be sure to save enough men for when the enemy sends out a counter-offensive. Every turn gets you one season closer to harsh winter conditions. Complete objective cards to gain bonuses and help your men conquer the world!

Check it out Below!

HBW Steam Link: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2199790/Home_Before_Winter_HBW/?beta=1&utm_source=44z&utm_campaign=hofl&utm_medium=e

notes.title: Mining bug fixed
notes.content:
We have fixed an elusive bug that happened when mining and pirate killing. If you would like to leave a review we would really appreciate it. Also, if you have any feedback or concerns please send them to the following:

feedback to feedback@corereactionstudios.com

Send any bugs to support@corereactionstudios.com

notes.title: Added a Space-City
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35176762/78c05df7409523529ab7e937249a9c8f19e073fb.png[/img]

We wanted to make the game feel more immersive and have added a Space-City that is around your Starbase. We have also added trade ships that fly across space. In addition to that, we have also added shields around your turrets to show how much health they have left.

notes.title: Asteroid Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35176762/d0dc121969ae476604b9d159c2190a352efab6d4.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

We changed the Asteroid belt to have the resources within the asteroids show through, and we also got rid of empty asteroids.

We fixed a small inventory bug that had to do with placing an ally fighter aircraft in your inventory. 

We got rid of the cost to shoot while inside of a turret. 

We have also changed the price of some items and resources.

Hope you enjoy,

Core Reaction Studios Team

Send any bugs to: support@corereactionstudios.com

And send any feedback to: feedback@corereactionstudios.com

We really enjoy hearing from you and making the game even better!

notes.title: Turret/Tutorial Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35176762/072796a372357c46037fd57a26c40c656df853b1.png[/img]

We've added in turrets to better counter enemy artillery. The Missile Silo turret targets and blows up artillery. The Shrapnel Shield defends adjacent turrets with a protective shield. The Anti-artillery turret shoots down enemy missiles. 

We've also made the tutorial nicer looking and easier to follow. Additionally we've made a few graphical changes. Finally, we have balanced the game more and are still making it just right.

Have fun,

Core Reaction Studios Team

notes.title: Save/Load Has Been Added
notes.content:
We've added an auto-save feature that saves your progress after you have hit "H" to begin a "Defense" Round. You can load the save from the Main-Menu. The save gets deleted if you lose your current game. 

We are also working on fixing a few glitches in regards to upgrading fighters and bombers. 

Please report any bugs to support@corereactionstudios.com

And any feedback to feedback@corereactionstudios.com


Thanks for the support,

Core Reaction Studios

notes.title: Balance Patch 1
notes.content:
Hi guys,

It has come to our attention that the game is too difficult at first. So we have lowered the amount of bombers and enemy ships that will attack you early on. Also, we have buffed the Anti-Air turrets and the Ally-Fighter. We are working on adding an Easy, Medium, and Hard mode, more on this in the future.

Thanks everyone who has given us feedback and hope you enjoy!

CoreReactionStudios Team
